# Dotstory

> Dotstory is a growth team for B2B tech companies above $10M ARR (SaaS, fintech and dev tools). It plans and runs organic and paid growth together: company and personal brand, SEO / AEO / GEO, programmatic advertising, paid social and search.

## Services
- [Organic and paid growth services](https://dotstory.io/services): company brand & content strategy, personal brand for founders & executives, SEO / AEO / GEO, programmatic advertising, paid social & search, and Paid Launchpad (a first paid campaign, start to finish)

## Company
- [About Dotstory](https://dotstory.io/about): why organic and paid work best as one team, who is behind the work, how onboarding and reporting work, and common questions
- [Contact](https://dotstory.io/contact): email hello@dotstory.io; replies within one business day

## Key facts
- 3.2x average pipeline growth within two quarters
- 47% lower cost per lead on average
- 156M impressions and reach in the past year
- 100+ growing tech companies worked with
- Kickoff to launch in two to three weeks; weekly reporting and a monthly strategic review
